sloka: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहस्तेन महाबलः ।विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां भ्रातृभिः सबलानुगैः ।। ७.११.४९ ॥
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahastena mahābalaḥ ।viveśa nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ bhrātṛbhiḥ sabalānugaiḥ ।। 7.11.49 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by Prahasta, the mighty Dashagriva entered the city of Lanka with his brothers, army, and followers.
